name: alazkan
description: Alazkan, the Svartalfar dark-elf assassin hero: pale lavender skin, long pointed ears, long black hair tied in a high ponytail, red eyes, black-and-purple leather armour with a purple mantle and brown straps, a purple cape trailing behind him, dark boots with pale trim, a dark steel kite shield on his RIGHT arm and a curved steel dagger in his LEFT hand
hands: the curved dagger stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the kite shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the curved dagger is lifted up over the head with its point up and back, kite shield held at his side
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the curved dagger cocked behind the head with its blade hanging down behind the shoulders, kite shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the curved dagger is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: dagger arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the curved dagger slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the curved dagger carries on down until its point nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, black ponytail and purple cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the curved dagger lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (kite shield flung out to the left, dagger arm thrown up and out), the purple cape flapping
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, curved dagger dipping, kite shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, dagger arm flung up, kite shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the curved dagger lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the point of the curved dagger resting on the ground, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the curved dagger slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the curved dagger lies on the ground at the lower-right; the kite shield lies flat beside him; the purple cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the shield rocks, the cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the curved dagger and the kite shield on the ground beside him
